display_long_description:
MirrorXR projects your **Android** screen to Quest headsets. You can manually resize the virtual display and operate your phone directly in VR—view messages, play mobile games, and browse short videos without removing the headset.
[media]

MirrorXR supports both real-time screen mirroring and single-app casting with high-resolution passthrough. It operates alongside other VR applications/games, allowing direct touch control on the projected content for a tablet-like interactive experience.

[media]

New features(beta):

​​- **Wired/Wireless pairing**​​: Connect via WiFi or cable for ultra-low latency 
[media]
​​- **Multi-window multitasking**​​: Run phone apps in separate windows for seamless multi-screen experience

[media]

This app offers a free trial. Please try it first before purchasing. Note that some features are in active development with basic functionality available, and we are continuously refining and expanding them. We recommend evaluating if the current features meet your needs before purchasing. We welcome any feedback if you encounter issues.

For additional help you can reach out on discord :  https://discord.gg/UhRh3FZPEb

**Privacy Statement:**

Your data stays private with end-to-end peer-to-peer connections. No additional data is collected or stored.
